variants.title: Kurie plot of Cs-137 with a magnetic spectrometer
variants.sample: Cs-137 source (Cs-137 to Ba-137m, 514 keV end point, K conversion line 624 keV)
variants.unknown: the end-point energy and the conversion-electron energy
variants.note: The magnet's current selects the momentum p = kI x I (calibrated with the conversion line); the window dp/p is fixed, so the counts follow F p^3 (W0 - W)^2 and the Kurie function is sqrt(N / (F p^3)). The 5.6 % branch to the Ba-137 ground state is left out.

variants.title: Kurie plot of Tl-204 with an anthracene spectrometer
variants.sample: Tl-204 source (Tl-204 to Pb-204, 763.7 keV end point)
variants.note: Tl-204 is a first-forbidden unique decay; its true Kurie plot curves unless the shape factor is applied. This simulation uses the allowed shape, so the plot is straight. End point from NNDC, from memory - verify.

variants.title: Kurie plot of Tl-204 with a magnetic spectrometer
variants.sample: Tl-204 source (Tl-204 to Pb-204, 763.7 keV end point)
variants.note: The allowed shape is used (the forbidden shape factor is left out). End point from NNDC, from memory - verify.

variants.title: Kurie plot of Sr-90/Y-90 with an anthracene spectrometer
variants.sample: Sr-90/Y-90 source in equilibrium (545.9 and 2278.5 keV end points)
variants.unknown: the end-point energy of the Y-90 betas
variants.note: Two beta groups of equal activity; above 0.6 MeV only the Y-90 group is left, and its straight Kurie line gives the end point. Allowed shapes are used. End points from NNDC, from memory - verify.

variants.title: Kurie plot of Sr-90/Y-90 with a magnetic spectrometer
variants.sample: Sr-90/Y-90 source in equilibrium (545.9 and 2278.5 keV end points)
variants.unknown: the end-point energy of the Y-90 betas
variants.note: The upper part of the spectrum is pure Y-90. Allowed shapes are used. End points from NNDC, from memory - verify.
